name: Warzone Acron
summary: Warzone Acron is a post-apocalyptic total conversion mod for Mount & Blade: Warband, inspired by Fallout. There is no main story; the player survives a hostile wasteland through combat, trade and crime. It features a reworked firearms system with aiming, scopes and dozens of weapons, a hitzone and wound system, NPCs that use cover, and survival mechanics like hunger, thirst and fatigue. Players can also travel by truck, rob towns, gamble and craft items. Compatible with WSE2.
